metadata.question: Did Lake Menindee, Australia shrink from February 2, 2019 to May 14, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user wants to know if Lake Menindee in Australia shrank between February 2, 2019 and May 14, 2021. Strategy: 1. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for water detection (good resolution, frequent coverage) 2. Define the lake area using a polygon around Lake Menindee 3. Compare water area at two time points: Feb 2, 2019 and May 14, 2021 4. Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water pixels 5. Count water pixels to estimate area Data quality considerations: - Check if images exist for both dates - Check if valid pixels remain after cloud masking - Validate the results (water area should be reasonable for a lake) For water detection, I'll use NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) where water typically has positive values. I need to: 1. Define Lake Menindee geometry 2. Get Sentinel-2 images for both dates 3. Mask clouds 4. Calculate NDWI and threshold for water 5. Count water pixels 6. Compare the counts If either collection is empty, try to recover by widening the date window. If no valid pixels after masking, output C2. If results are invalid (negative area, etc.), output C3. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeMenindee = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [142.35, -32.25], [142.45, -32.25], [142.45, -32.35], [142.35, -32.35], [142.35, -32.25] ]); const date1 = '2019-02-02'; const date2 = '2021-05-14'; // 2. Data Acquisition function getWaterArea(date) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeMenindee) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'month')); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return {area: null, pixels: 0, images: 0, status: 'no_images'}; } // Get least cloudy image const image = collection.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // Cloud masking const cloudMask = image.select('MSK_CLDPRB').lt(20); const maskedImage = image.updateMask(cloudMask); // Calculate NDWI for water detection const ndwi = maskedImage.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Water threshold (NDWI > 0 typically indicates water) const water = ndwi.gt(0.1); // Count water pixels const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeMenindee, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels = stats.get('NDWI').getInfo(); return {area: waterPixels, pixels: waterPixels, images: size, status: 'success'}; } // Get water areas for both dates const area2019 = getWaterArea(date1); const area2021 = getWaterArea(date2); // 3. Check for data issues if (area2019.status === 'no_images' || area2021.status === 'no_images') { console.log(`2019 Images: ${area2019.images} (Area: ${area2019.area})`); console.log(`2021 Images: ${area2021.images} (Area: ${area2021.area})`); console.log("C1"); return; } if (area2019.pixels === 0 || area2021.pixels === 0) { console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${area2019.pixels}`); console.log(`2021 Water Pixels: ${area2021.pixels}`); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`2019 Water Area: ${area2019.area.toFixed(0)} pixels`); console.log(`2021 Water Area: ${area2021.area.toFixed(0)} pixels`); console.log(`Change: ${((area2021.area - area2019.area) / area2019.area * 100).toFixed(1)}%`); // Check if shrank (2021 area < 2019 area) if (area2021.area < area2019.area) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
